source: Activations are produced as the model executes. Their lifetime depends on training versus inference, fusion, checkpointing, and the operator graph. Some intermediates are consumed immediately, while others must survive much longer.
zh: 激活是在模型执行时产生的。 Their lifetime depends on training versus inference, fusion, checkpointing, and the operator graph.一些中间体会立即被消耗，而另一些则必须存活更长时间。
